title: Property Preservation Desk Note: Occupancy Finding Days on a Further Extension in Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases
content:
**Rule.** For a further extension on a Cedarline Summit loan's Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases case, the most recent occupancy inspection finding on the borrower's occupancy profile (Occupancy and Residency Certification) adds days to the extension length:

- Where the finding is that the home is occupied by someone other than a borrower, 7 calendar days are added.
- Where the finding is that the home is vacant, 3 calendar days are added to it.
- Any other finding, or none, adds nothing.

**Same-day findings.** Where two occupancy inspection findings carry the same most recent date, a finding that the home is occupied by someone other than a borrower prevails over a finding that it is vacant, and a vacant finding prevails over any other finding.

| Most recent finding | Days added to the extension length |
|---|---|
| occupied by someone other than a borrower | 7 |
| vacant | 3 |
| other, or none | 0 |

## Hypothetical illustration

An inspection last year found the home vacant. A later inspection found it owner-occupied, which is a finding of another kind. The later finding governs, so nothing is added.
